relations.name: invoice_record
relations.meaning: One represented billed-revenue invoice row as authored in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/billing/invoices.json by invoice_id with field values copied verbatim.
relations.construction_rule: C1 parse invoices.json; emit invoice join key as invoice:<invoice_id>; one tuple per source invoice.

relations.name: crm_account_record
relations.meaning: One CRM account row as authored in the CRM export.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/crm.csv by crm_account_id with account_name copied verbatim.
relations.construction_rule: C1 parse crm.csv; emit account join key as crm:<crm_account_id>; one tuple per CRM row.

relations.name: registry_entity_record
relations.meaning: One company-registry row as authored in the registry export.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/company_registry.csv by company_number with legal_name copied verbatim.
relations.construction_rule: C1 parse company_registry.csv; emit entity join key as registry:<company_number>; one tuple per registry row.

relations.name: contract_record
relations.meaning: One contract document header with source-native identifier, counterparty line, document kind, and explicit expiry when stated.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/contracts/<contract_id>.md header fields; expiry_date populated only when the source states an explicit expiry.
relations.construction_rule: C1 parse contract markdown filenames and header lines; emit contract join key as contract:<filename_without_md>; contract_id is the bare filename stem.

relations.name: contract_clause_excerpt
relations.meaning: A contiguous clause excerpt from a contract section used as evidence for semantic clause judgments.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to a specific section span in sources/contracts/<contract_id>.md.
relations.construction_rule: C1 split contract markdown by numbered sections; emit one tuple per section with section_label and excerpt text.

relations.name: commercial_note_observation
relations.meaning: A discrete factual observation extracted from internal commercial notes.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to a sentence or bullet span in sources/commercial_notes.md.
relations.construction_rule: C1 segment commercial_notes.md into grounded observation tuples without resolving identity or contractual judgments.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: C2 emit candidate pairs along required commercial connection paths; C3 ground each asserted SAME_ENTITY or DISTINCT disposition.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate oriented pairs connecting crm accounts, billing billed names, governing contracts, and registry candidate entities for commercially relevant relationships; include mechanically equivalent legal-name variants per purpose B policy.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether left and right identifier-form referents denote the same legal counterparty.

relations.name: obligation_clause_presence
relations.meaning: An active-contract obligation kind (exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term) is present in contract text or remains unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing contract_clause_excerpt spans; PRESENT requires explicit contractual language for the kind.
relations.construction_rule: C2 one candidate per (contract, allowed obligation kind); C3 assert PRESENT only with grounded excerpt evidence.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each contract_record and each obligation kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}, emit one candidate tuple.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract text establishes the named obligation kind.

relations.name: acquisition_clause_presence
relations.meaning: A purpose-A acquisition-relevant clause kind is present in contract text or remains unresolved under the purpose taxonomy.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing contract_clause_excerpt spans; PRESENT requires explicit language matching a purpose-A allowed kind.
relations.construction_rule: C2 one candidate per (contract, purpose-A allowed acquisition kind); C3 assert PRESENT only with grounded excerpt evidence.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each contract_record and each allowed acquisition kind in contracts/purpose_a.json, emit one candidate tuple.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract text contains an acquisition-relevant condition of the named kind.

relations.name: legal_name_variant_pair
relations.meaning: Two name strings are exact legal-form variants eligible for mechanical SAME_ENTITY promotion.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over registry_entity_record and invoice/crm name fields using deterministic legal-suffix normalization only.
relations.construction_rule: C4 deterministic normalization (e.g., Ltd/Limited, Inc.) pairs registry legal_name with billing or CRM surface names; does not assert identity by itself.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoices whose billing status is non-terminal/open per source-authored status values.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over invoice_record with explicit open-status filter documented in basis.
relations.construction_rule: C4 SELECT from invoice_record WHERE status indicates open (e.g., status = 'open').

relations.name: purpose_a_active_contract
relations.meaning: Whether a contract is active for purpose A exposure, applying the expired-SOW exclusion policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over contract_record applying purpose-A active_contract_rule; not a global lifecycle fact.
relations.construction_rule: C4 mark active=false when document_kind is SOW and expiry_date is in the past or source states non-renewal; otherwise active=true for MSAs and unexpired documents.

relations.name: purpose_c_active_contract
relations.meaning: Whether a contract is active for purpose C dependency evaluation, excluding expired contracts.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over contract_record applying purpose-C active_contract_for_dependency policy.
relations.construction_rule: C4 mark active=false when contract_record shows explicit expiry in the past or source states expiration; active=true otherwise.

relations.name: purpose_a_exposure_invoice
relations.meaning: Purpose A output row: represented invoice tied to an active acquisition-exposed contract with asserted or unresolved association.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt joining invoice_record, purpose_a_active_contract, acquisition_clause_presence, and identity_judgment; association maps SAME_ENTITY to asserted and UNRESOLVED to unresolved.
relations.construction_rule: C4 include invoice when linked contract is purpose-A active and has at least one acquisition_clause_presence PRESENT; emit association from identity path between billing:<billed_name> and governing contract/counterparty referents.

relations.name: purpose_b_identity_link
relations.meaning: Purpose B output link with epistemic disposition over required commercially relevant identifier-form pairs.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over identity_judgment restricted to purpose-B required connection paths; DISTINCT maps from REJECT when present.
relations.construction_rule: C4 project identity_judgment tuples for required crm–billing, commercial–contract, and registry-candidate pairs; sort by left then right for output.

relations.name: purpose_c_dependency_row
relations.meaning: Purpose C output row: counterparty–contract dependency status with open invoices and sorted obligation kinds.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt composing open_invoice, purpose_c_active_contract, obligation_clause_presence, and identity_judgment; unresolved identity forces status unresolved.
relations.construction_rule: C4 emit dependent when current relationship holds (open invoice OR active contract with auto_renewal or rolling_term PRESENT) AND at least one obligation_clause_presence PRESENT; otherwise unresolved when identity join blocks evaluation.
